Title: Public preview: Artifact streaming support in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Body.Content:
You can now accelerate your containerized workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using Azure Container Registry (ACR) artifact streaming. Artifact streaming will allow you to scale your workloads without having to fully wait for images to be pulled into the clusters.

Artifact Streaming is available now for Linux-based container images via the ACR and AKS Preview API. CLI and Portal support will be available in the next two weeks.

To learn more, visit https://aka.ms/artifactstreaming
